test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question: **Select the misspelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is **'descrete'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • In the given options 'descrete' is an incorrectly spelt word. Its correct spelling is 'Discrete'. • Let's look at its meaning: • Discrete: individually separate and distinct. (व्यक्तिगत रूप से अलग और विशिष्ट) • *Example: Speech sounds are produced as a continuous sound signal rather than **discrete** units.* • Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 4.​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words given in the other options: **Words** **Meaning** Ascertain to find something out. (कुछ पता लगाना) Inherit to receive property, money, etc. from somebody who has died. (मृतक की संपत्ति, धन आदि को (उत्तराधिकार या विरासत के रूप में) प्राप्‍त करना) Glorify to make somebody/something appear better or more important than he/she/it really is. (बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर कहना) b6:T113c, The correct answer is **'whom'.**
